htmlLang.description: BCP 47 code of this translation, used for <html lang>. Not shown to users.

extName.message: Kiosk Exit Button: Close Chrome Kiosk Mode Without a Keyboard
extName.description: Store and extension name. Max 75 characters. Keep 'Kiosk Exit Button' untranslated.

extDescription.message: Add an on-screen close button to Chrome kiosk mode. Exit with one click, no keyboard shortcuts needed. Customizable, auto-hides.

popupLoading.description: Screen-reader text for the popup spinner.

popupChecking.description: Popup status while checking for kiosk mode.

popupActive.description: Popup status when Chrome is in kiosk mode.

popupInactive.description: Popup status when Chrome is not in kiosk mode.

openSettings.description: Popup button that opens the options page.

optionsPageTitle.description: Browser tab title of the options page.

optionsHeading.description: Main heading of the options page.

toastClose.description: Accessible label for the toast close button.

textAndColor.description: Label for the text and color inputs.

resetDefault.description: Resets the image to the bundled default.

autoHideLabel.description: Label for the auto-hide delay input.

autoHideHelp.message: Button will hide after this many seconds of mouse inactivity. Set to 0 to keep always visible.

previewInfo.message: This preview shows how your exit button will appear on websites. You can adjust the settings on the left to customize its appearance.

tip1.message: The button will always stay in the selected corner of the screen

tip2.message: Text buttons work best with short text (1-3 characters)

tip3.message: For image buttons, use a transparent, square PNG for best results

toastHeadsUp.description: Toast title for a non-fatal problem.

toastLoadFailed.message: Saved settings could not be loaded, showing defaults.
toastLoadFailed.description: Shown when stored settings cannot be read.

toastImageNotLoaded.description: Upload failed. $REASON$ is errFileUnreadable or errNotImage.

reason.example: the file is not a readable image

errFileUnreadable.message: the file could not be read

errNotImage.message: the file is not a readable image

toastSaveFailed.description: Save failed. $DETAIL$ is Chrome's (English) error text.

autoHideInvalid.message: Enter a whole number of seconds between 0 and 300
autoHideInvalid.description: Validation message for the auto-hide input.
